description:
Master your confidence step by step with Charisma University:
https://bit.ly/026-25


There is one common mistake that kills your confidence. It makes you look weak, it makes you feel smaller, and it pushes people away. In this video, we’ll use Ned Fulmer’s recent podcast with his ex-wife Ariel Fulmer, to show the habit that destroys both your confidence and people’s trust.


0:00 - Intro 
0:16 - Context
0:41 - His voice is constricted
1:47 - What you should do instead 
2:31 - Do this when you start to feel constricted
